description: This file implements a fault injection decorator for Orleans grain storage providers, allowing simulation of storage faults and latency for testing purposes. It includes classes for options configuration, the storage decorator, and a factory for creating instances.

classes.name: FaultInjectionGrainStorageOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for fault injection, including latency settings.

classes.name: FaultInjectionGrainStorage
classes.description: Decorator class that injects faults and latency into storage operations for testing.

classes.name: FaultInjectionGrainStorageFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of FaultInjectionGrainStorage.

methods.name: InsertDelay
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for the configured latency duration.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads state from storage, injecting faults or delays as configured.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Writes state to storage, injecting faults or delays as configured.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears state in storage, injecting faults or delays as configured.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Participates in the silo lifecycle if the underlying storage provider supports it.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new FaultInjectionGrainStorage instance with dependencies injected.
